_README: Template for a new migration run. Copy to plans/<PROJECT>.plan.json and replace every __PLACEHOLDER__. Then: bash orchestration/run.sh plans/<PROJECT>.plan.json. Placeholders: __PROJECT__ (folder under projects/, e.g. acme), __SITE_URL__ (reference URL), __NAMESPACE__ (CND namespace, e.g. acme), __MIX_NAMESPACE__ (e.g. acmemix), __SITE_KEY__ (Jahia siteKey), __LANG__ (primary language, e.g. en), __PAGES__ (comma-separated page slugs, home first), __REPO_ABS_PATH__ (absolute path to jahiaMigration). Prereq: projects/__PROJECT__/.env must define JAHIA_USER, JAHIA_HOST, and JAHIA_MCP_TOKEN (gitignored). The structure mirrors plans/sial-paris.plan.json; keep the PROBE: lines verbatim.
goal: Migrate __SITE_URL__ to a Jahia JS module (project: __PROJECT__, namespace __NAMESPACE__, siteKey __SITE_KEY__, language __LANG__). Each step is proven by its PROBE command; a step is done only when the probe exits 0.

epics.title: Foundation: connect + analyze
epics.goal: Confirm Jahia reachable and produce a complete component/content manifest.

stories.title: Analyze the reference site
stories.description: Verify connectivity, then analyze __SITE_URL__ into a manifest and content data.

steps.title: Verify Jahia connection (Gate 0)
acceptance_criteria: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/connect.sh projects/__PROJECT__

steps.title: Analyze -> manifest (Gate 1: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Use the namespace provided in inputs (__NAMESPACE__ / __MIX_NAMESPACE__) for EVERY nodeType in component-manifest.json — do NOT invent a different prefix.

Content with its own navigable URL (news/blog articles, press releases, events, products) are jmix:mainResource detail content types: needsMainResource:true with both a default (card) and fullPage view.

BROWSER-FIRST CAPTURE (anti-hallucination): if the site is JS-rendered or behind a WAF, the wget cache is only the static shell. Per .agents/skills/capture-reference/SKILL.md, capture via the browser (Chrome MCP) each page's real rendered text, the COMPLETE item list, real image URLs, and facet/taxonomy values + counts, into projects/__PROJECT__/.reference/captured/. Build content-data.json from this captured truth — never fabricate summaries/titles/taxonomy/images.
Write ALL 4 SKILL Step 8 outputs: analysis.md, component-manifest.json, content-data.json, asset-inventory.json.

If the source is Sitecore SXA (.component / .component-content / field-* in the cached DOM), components are DECLARED in the markup — do NOT eyeball-discover them. Per .agents/skills/sitecore-sxa/SKILL.md, run the deterministic extractor (python3 orchestration/lib/sxa-extract.py projects/

/.reference/cache > projects/

/.reference/sxa-components.json) and account for EVERY extracted component in component-manifest.json: each Jahia type carries sxaSource:[...]; deliberately-skipped generics go in a top-level sxaIgnored:[...]. No silent drops.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/sxa-coverage.sh projects/__PROJECT__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/analyze.sh projects/__PROJECT__
Gate 1: present section map + field splits, return status halt.

steps.title: Implement components
acceptance_criteria: Implement components ONE at a time — never batch-stub them all then build at the end. The build-time gate here is components-all.sh: it validates source-pairing + no-stub + en/fr i18n for EVERY component and builds once. NOTE: component-validate.sh additionally DEPLOYS and RENDERS a non-home page, so it only passes AFTER content/pages exist — it is a POST-CONTENT per-component debugging gate (used while iterating on a single deployed component), NOT run at this step.

Per-component completeness gate over EVERY component (loops each, FAILS naming any stubbed / unlabelled / viewless component, builds the module once): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/components-all.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__

steps.title: Layout + templates
acceptance_criteria: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/templates.sh projects/__PROJECT__

Render-gate the deployed shell (header/nav/footer must not be collapsed/broken): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/render-all.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ /home
Gate 3: present deployed shell screenshot, return status halt.

epics.title: Content + review + accessibility
epics.goal: Create + publish all content, review, accessibility audit.

stories.title: Create + publish content
stories.description: Create and publish all pages (__PAGES__) to live.

steps.title: Create content (Gate 4: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Use the Jahia MCP server (JSON-RPC at $JAHIA_HOST/modules/mcp) for ALL node creation, property edits, and publishing. GraphQL is a fallback only when the MCP cannot do it; state any fallback in the summary.

IMAGES = DAM weakreferences, NEVER url strings (AGENTS.md 2a). Import via MCP media.upload.url (consistent UUID), set the WEAKREFERENCE field (image/backgroundImage/logo/photo), clear any *ExternalUrl string. Canonical tools: orchestration/images/set_hero_refs.py and set_image_refs.py __PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __NAMESPACE__. Capture source URLs via browser (site blocks the agent).
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/mcp.sh projects/__PROJECT__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ __PAGES__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-url-images.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __NAMESPACE__

Render-gate EACH page as you finish it (do not defer to the end). The step is not done until every page renders clean: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/render-all.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ __PAGES__

Publish completeness: every weakref'd asset (image/logo/link/category) must resolve in LIVE and every translation must be published (publish WITH languages:[__LANG__]): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/publish-parity.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__

Editability: shared regions (nav/footer/topbar) must render AND be editable in Page Builder, not blank (AbsoluteAreas need child content nodes): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/edit-frame.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ home

Quality: every page passes a11y (axe-core, no critical/serious) + SEO baseline (title, meta, single h1, img alt): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/site-review.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ __PAGES__

Reuse guard: content/page discovery must NOT add types beyond the approved per-project baseline (reuse a type or add a view instead): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__ projects/__PROJECT__/component-baseline.txt
Gate 4: present reference vs Jahia screenshots, return status halt.

stories.title: Review + accessibility
stories.description: Code review + axe-core audit; write reports.

steps.title: Code review (Gate 5: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Use the jahia-reviewer agent (.claude/agents/jahia-reviewer.md): run ALL gate probes (no-stub, cnd-review, render-all, publish-parity, edit-frame, site-review) and review faithful-DOM/editability/content-fidelity/i18n; write REVIEW.md with a verdict. APPROVE only if every gate is green and no critical/major finding stands.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/artifact.sh projects/__PROJECT__/workflow-output/review/REVIEW.md
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-stub.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/cnd-review.sh projects/__PROJECT__
Reuse/views: no two types may share a property shape (consolidate into one type + views): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/dup-shapes.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__

Reuse guard against the FROZEN baseline (do NOT re-write it here — it was frozen at step_content_types): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__ projects/__PROJECT__/component-baseline.txt
Gate 5: present findings, return status halt.
